paragraphs.text: Selena Mistencharmer was an artificer and mage.

During the Great Magus War on Antausia , Selena and Slides Stardust assembled small hordes at Mount Margalus. They defeated the evil Mandrake Nightshade with his dragons and pit lords. The mountain has since become known as Mandrake's Mountain. Upon his death, Selena and Slides feared his possible resurrection, so they put a dangerous curse on the mountain that would drain anyone who set foot on the mountain.

Exhausted, Selena retreated to her laboratory in Bosconius, where Rostov Maelstrom ambushed her. She focused all her power into a celestial prism she had made, then shattered it, releasing a rainbow of her power above the city. Although Rostov dispatched her easily, her eternal rainbow continues to transform the city's magic from one color to another.
